title: Introduce SG change-review hook and configurable DNS propagation delay for private control plane
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Added a security-group change-review webhook and a configurable DNS propagation delay in the private installer. Operators can opt into automatic SG edits or require manual approval; DNS handoffs wait for a configurable propagation window before signaling healthy. Includes Terraform outputs for new resources and Helm values to control behavior.
description: Context: Several customer installs reported transient outages during control plane maintenance when security group edits and endpoint reconfigurations happened in quick succession. Root cause: aggressive immediate SG mutations plus near-zero DNS handoff timeout caused health checks to mis-evaluate control plane endpoints during rollout. This PR introduces two operator-facing controls to reduce blast radius and provide safer upgrade/rollback windows: 1) a change-review hook for security-group edits that can be configured in the private installer to require explicit approval for SG diffs affecting control-plane endpoints; 2) a configurable DNS propagation delay that postpones marking new endpoints healthy until DNS changes have had time to propagate across the customer's resolver topology. The description below lists implementation details, testing, and operational guidance. Implementation notes: - Installer control plane: added a new optional controller component (sg-change-review) which runs as a Kubernetes Job for on-prem and as a lightweight service for VPC installs. The controller computes a minimal diff for SGs attached to control-plane ENIs and emits a review webhook payload to the operator endpoint (or uses the built-in automatic-approve mode). - Terraform modules: exposed two new module inputs (enable_sg_review = bool, dns_propagation_delay_seconds = int) and outputs (sg_review_webhook_url, sg_review_pending_count) so downstream automation can surface pending approvals. - Helm chart: introduced values.install.sgReview and values.install.dnsPropagation.delaySeconds with sensible defaults (false and 30s respectively) and clear docs for enabling strict mode. - Rollout behavior: when sg review is enabled and set to manual, the installer will stage SG changes and pause before applying them; an operator can approve via a short REST endpoint or the installer CLI (cli approve-sg-change <id>). - Telemetry and ops: added metrics (installer_sg_changes_staged, installer_sg_changes_approved, installer_dns_propagation_wait_seconds) and new logs at INFO/WARN to help debugging. - Safety: if the webhook service is unreachable for more than 10 minutes and operator has set strict_mode = true, the installer will fail fast and roll back to previous SGs to avoid leaving control plane in a partially configured state. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module changes with backward-compatible inputs - [x] Helm chart schema bump and docs - [x] sg-change-review controller implementation with auto-approve and manual modes - [x] e2e tests simulating delayed DNS propagation and SG approval flows - [x] unit tests for webhook payload signing and reconciliation loop - [x] updated upgrade notes and rollback instructions Usage and upgrade notes: - Default behavior is opt-out: existing installs see no change. - To enable manual review: set enable_sg_review = true and install the webhook receiver (or set automatic_approve = false). - To increase DNS delay for long-tail resolvers, set dns_propagation_delay_seconds to a value appropriate for your environment (default 30 seconds). - Rollback: use installer rollback command which will revert SG diffs staged but not applied; if rollback is initiated after SGs are applied, the installer will attempt to apply the previous SG set and re-run DNS handoff with the configured delay. Risks and mitigation: - Risk: misconfigured webhook URL could block upgrades. Mitigation: installer detects unreachable webhook and can be configured to auto-approve after configurable grace period or fail-fast if operator prefers. - Risk: long DNS delay increases total upgrade time. Mitigation: recommend incremental increases and measurement via installer_dns_propagation_wait_seconds metric. Related: ENG-4128 (control plane resilience), ENG-4199 (installer upgrade safety).

review_comments: Ethan Zhang: Can you explain the webhook signing approach? We need to avoid replay attacks. — addressed in e88b3d0; payloads now include nonce and timestamp and are HMAC-signed.
Priya Ramesh: How does this behave for existing installs that don't set the new inputs? — default is disabled, existing behavior unchanged.
Liam O'Connor: Add a healthcheck for the sg-change-review service so autoscalers can detect failure. — added readiness/liveness probes and documented expected HPA behavior.
Ethan Zhang: Unit tests for the reconcile loop look light; add a failure scenario where webhook times out. — added test case in d5f6a11 and integration test simulating timeout.
Priya Ramesh: Please include guidance in upgrade notes about rolling back if webhook URL misconfigured. — expanded docs in installer/docs/upgrade_sg_review.md
ci_check_summary: ci/go-unit: fail on first run (flaky webhook test), re-run succeeded
ci/e2e: pass (dns propagation scenario ran with simulated resolver)
merge_outcome: Merged by squash/merge after approvals from Ethan Zhang and Priya Ramesh. CI green after test rerun. Deployed to staging via canary job; observed expected metrics for staged SG changes.
notes_for_ops: Operators should audit webhook endpoints before enabling manual mode. For critical installs, set automatic_approve = true but enable longer DNS delay to allow resolvers to converge. Monitor installer_sg_changes_pending and installer_dns_propagation_wait_seconds during rollout.
testing_summary: Added targeted unit tests for signature validation and reconcile logic, integration tests for webhook approval flow, and e2e job that simulates slow DNS by delaying DNS responses in a local resolver. All tests run in the pipeline and were rerun on flaky case.
backport_plan: Backport to release/2025Q4 only if customers request SG review prior to full release; requires Terraform module version bump and chart release. No automatic backport scheduled.
